headline: Canary Islands grows three times less than the Spanish average in October, weighed down by Aena fee increases
summary: The Canary Islands recorded 4.6 million travellers in October, up 1%, but traffic fell 0.2% in 2026 versus a 4% rise across Aena's national network. Aena fee increases weighed on growth.
why: Aena operates Spain's largest airport network, so passenger volumes and fee changes affect its revenues and the tourism economy of regions like the Canary Islands.

impacts.name: Aena
impacts.why: Passenger traffic gains are mixed across regions, and fee increases affect airport demand.
